review_method: Limited read-only source inspection. No build, compiler execution, runtime test, or performance measurement.
verdict: Minimal ownership lifetime can be implemented without retaining the full legacy pass manager or changing existing class layouts. Direct repeated AsmPrinter emission remains unsafe without a complete emission binding/overlay and fresh provider contract.

closed_by_source.finding: finalize resets internal Context and deletes ObjFileMMI, explicitly leaves ExternalContext alone, and does not erase the MF map. Actual per-function destruction is FreeMachineFunction calling deleteMachineFunctionFor. Original finalization can run when external context owns all admitted MF MC dependencies and no retained object depends on deleted ObjFileMMI.
Existing ExternalContext constructor/getContext and embedded wrapper MMI permit a heap external context plus stable-address wrapper; no owner-layout field is required.
Do not move MMI itself: its move constructor constructs a new internal context while moving MachineFunctions; that is not MF reference rebinding.

ImmutablePass ownership resides in the top-level ImmutablePasses vector; top-level destruction deletes contained managers before immutable passes. Ordinary PMDataManager deletion owns PassVector. A terminal unique-ownership extraction for the exact MMI wrapper is structurally possible.

Pass destructor deletes Resolver. setResolver asserts the resolver was unset; setResolver(nullptr) is not detachment. Add a field-neutral detachAnalysisResolver method that deletes the existing resolver and sets its field to null.
Inspected AsmPrinter destructor only invokes its debug/EH finalized assertion; it does not itself query MMI analysis.

prototype_lifetime_contract: Allocate external MCContext and original-address MMIWrapper on heap; own Module, LLVMContext and TargetMachine for the complete region lifetime.
Keep original complete pass execution and finalizers. At FreeMachineFunction, retain only sealed admitted MF entries; ordinary entries retain original deletion behavior.
After whole-object success and complete sequence checks, terminal takeImmutablePass removes exactly the wrapper from owning ImmutablePasses and transfers unique ownership without moving it.

After take, the old PM may only be destroyed. Its lookup map may retain a borrowed wrapper pointer until destruction so remaining destructors preserve lookup availability; it must never resume execution.
Keep wrapper alive through old PM destruction; then detach its resolver before seal/publication. No old wrapper reinitialization, re-addition to a PM, or old-analysis access.
Destroy wrapper/MFs before external MCContext; destroy external MCContext before TargetMachine; keep Module and LLVMContext alive until all MF users are gone, and destroy Module before LLVMContext.
Seal requires no dependency on finalized ObjFileMMI, no MF Observer and no MF Delegate. Observer is already checked by the existing domain; a field-neutral private-state query can cover Delegate.
Account actual retained owner allocations as a region: retaining one MF may retain an entire Module/TM. Logical serialized snapshot bytes are not a region resident-memory bound.

emission_source_blockers.finding: MBB caches normal, EH-continuation and end symbols from MF.getContext. A preserved owner is not a fresh object-emission symbol state.
emitLabel registers the symbol and writes its current fragment/offset. Reusing a first-object symbol in a new streamer is incorrect; resetting its context instead invalidates the cached pointer.
MF owns references to Function, Target, Subtarget and MCContext, plus section and function-number state. A symbol-only overlay is incomplete.
AP writes MF section and reads MF context/function number; its analysis-provider adapters cannot silently use a retained historical Function in the current PM.
X86 AP queries PSI/SDPI with MF parent Module and creates a code emitter using MF.getContext; current emission binding must cover these paths.
getPICBaseSymbol directly reads Ctx, bypassing a getContext-only overlay; route it explicitly or reject the relevant opcode domain.
MOVPC32r emission mutates X86MachineFunctionInfo HasCFIAdjustCfa. Reject this pseudo in the initial domain or implement a complete scoped write strategy.

required_emission_design_not_yet_proven: Use the overlay on the first emission as well as reuse: current object MCContext, current function number, per-MBB symbols and current section must not mutate the sealed product.
Retain original AsmPrinter/CFI/MC execution with fresh current-request providers. Explicitly bind current Function/Module for ORE/MDT/MLI/PSI/SDPI interactions; unknown providers decline reuse.

Preserve existing snapshot-domain exclusions, including IR/MMO/Alloca/constant-pool/jump-table/debug/EH/blockaddress/symbol owners. Initial admitted domain remains x86_64 ELF scalar/no-call with covered stack/FI/CFI state.

Run MachineVerifier on the actual live retained MF each borrow. Complete current Input, World and canonical pipeline values authorize product consumption; do not claim this is a newly constructed current-owner MF.
Prove all admitted AP/target writes are overlay-local or explicitly restored, and final sealed Module/World remains consistent with the pre-emission bound input.
Unknown ownership, analysis-provider or emission-write state falls back to original fresh compilation.

performance_non_claims.statement: These are gross opportunities only. Admission/sealing, retained-MF verification, overlay/provider work and full-owner memory accounting remain payable. No measured saving or full-O2 completion claim.
